title: Gaggle
description: A siloed workforce within an instance (GAG-001..007).

apiVersion.description: API version of this gaggle definition.

metadata.description: Identity and optional labels or annotations for this gaggle.

spec.description: The gaggle's project, backlog, isolation boundary, and shared runner settings.

displayName.description: Human-facing gaggle name shown in the portal.

selfIdentity.description: Provider login used as this gaggle's self identity for assignment-aware backlog operations. Omitted inherits instance.yaml selfIdentity.

project.description: Primary code repository this gaggle works on.

backlog.description: Singleton source of work-item truth for this gaggle.

namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace reserved for this gaggle's workloads and secrets.

identityRef.description: Per-gaggle Azure workload identity used for external services.

additionalRepos.description: Optional reference repositories supplied read-only to runs in addition to the primary project.

ciCommand.description: Per-gaggle local CI-equivalent command run by the deterministic local-ci stage instead of its declared default (MGV-1/#1009).

requiredCapabilities.description: Runner (toolchain/platform) capabilities every run of this gaggle needs, matched at schedule time against a runner's advertised set (RRQ-1/#1101).

branchNamespace.description: refs/heads/ root this gaggle's run branches live under (providers.BranchName). Empty defaults to 'goobers/'. A trailing slash is optional. Must be a valid ref-path segment sequence (#965/#1010).

runControls.description: Gaggle-level overrides for instance runner safety budgets.

outboxMirrorPath.description: Default absolute local filesystem root (or ~/ path) where workflows additionally mirror durable journal outbox files.

sandbox.description: Per-gaggle override of the instance-wide isolation posture for agentic stages (#1305). Omitted inherits the instance posture; the default is disabled (opt-in).

agentic.description: Isolation posture for agentic stages. Omitted inherits the instance posture.

workcopies.description: Per-gaggle override for managed working-copy placement. The gaggle name and repository key are appended beneath this base path.

root.description: Absolute base path for this gaggle's managed mirrors and worktrees. Overrides instance.yaml workcopies.root.

requireLabels.description: Default requireLabels value every workflow's backlog-query task in this gaggle inherits unless the task declares its own requireLabels input (full replace, not merge — same shape as branchNamespace/headPrefix) (MIRC-2, #1901).

siblings.description: Other gaggles/instances known to independently work the same target repo, for the sibling-overlap validation warning (MIRC-2, #1901).

metadata.description: Deliberately left open (no additionalProperties:false) unlike the rest of this schema: k8s-style metadata objects tolerate forward-compatible extra fields (e.g. a future resourceVersion) by convention (#125).

name.description: DNS-label-compatible gaggle name, unique within the instance.

labels.description: String labels used to organize this gaggle.

annotations.description: Non-identifying string metadata attached to this gaggle.

repoRef.description: Provider-neutral reference to a git repository and its credential connection.

baseUrl.description: Forge root URL (e.g. https://gitea.example.com); required when provider is gitea, since self-hosted Gitea has no fixed host.

owner.description: GitHub organization or user, or Azure DevOps organization.

project.description: Azure DevOps project. Omit for GitHub repositories.

branch.description: Default branch checked out by runs. Omitted defaults to main.

connectionRef.description: Manifest connection that supplies credentials for this repository.

checkout.description: Partial-checkout declaration (B2, #649). Accepted but not honored by the local runner yet — inert, surfaced as a VER003 compatibility warning at validate time.

sparse.description: Repo-relative path cones a sparse checkout materializes. Empty means a full checkout.

gaggleSibling.description: Another gaggle/instance known to independently work the same target repo — identified by target repo, never by gaggle name (MIRC-2, #1901).

project.description: Repo the sibling gaggle targets — the sole match key (provider/owner/name).

label.description: Human-readable name for the sibling, used only in warning messages.

requireLabels.description: This gaggle's own trusted declaration of the sibling's effective required-label scope.

runnerCapability.description: A free-form, version-parameterized runner capability token (e.g. dotnet@8, xcode, os=windows) — distinct from a credential capability. An alphanumeric start then letters, digits, and any of . _ - + @ =, no whitespace.

runControls.description: Runner-level safety budgets inherited by this gaggle's workflows. Omitted fields retain instance defaults.

maxRepasses.description: Maximum number of times gates may cumulatively route a run back to the same already-completed stage before escalation, regardless of gate or outcome.

stalledRunTimeout.description: Maximum journal-silent period before watchdog escalation, expressed as a Go duration.

maxRunDuration.description: Maximum total wall-clock age of a run, expressed as a Go duration. Omit to disable.

backlogRef.description: Provider-neutral reference to the singleton backlog a gaggle draws work from.

baseUrl.description: Forge root URL (e.g. https://gitea.example.com); required when provider is gitea, since self-hosted Gitea has no fixed host.

project.description: GitHub owner/repository or Azure DevOps project that scopes the backlog.

labels.description: Required labels used to narrow candidate work items.

labelPredicate.description: CEL label-set predicate using only string membership in `labels` and boolean &&, ||, and !. ANDed with labels.

fieldPredicate.description: CEL predicate over the provider's typed native-field projection. ANDed with labels; unavailable fields are errors.

query.description: Provider-specific query used to narrow candidate work items.

connectionRef.description: Manifest connection that supplies credentials for this backlog.
